'''Faa'i Lethax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] working as bookkeeper for [[Vorse Tabarith]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the auction of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], he wanted to joined up with [[Kaltho]]'s [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]].
